findings: The extracted beta V366 renderer still carried its historical V4.29 Stable constant.
On boot and DOMContentLoaded it scanned multiple generic version selectors and rewrote them to V4.29 Stable, while the current beta build label is V8.009.
The visible beta CSS override hid most of that stale write, but the underlying DOM and unrelated version nodes could still be wrong.
changes: The canonical beta header now writes V8.009 directly into .v366-ver.
Existing mounted headers are synchronized only at their own .v366-ver node.
The document-wide V4.29 version writer and its DOMContentLoaded scan are retired.
Shared/stable version files and Server 1 behavior are unchanged.
Browser QA verifies the header label with the helper layer disabled and verifies unrelated version nodes remain untouched.
